initialExam.title: SSC JHT 2026 (Junior Hindi Translator)
initialExam.description: Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Translator, Senior Hindi Translator, and Hindi Pradhyapak examination for translation posts in central government ministries and departments.
initialExam.eligibility: Master's Degree in Hindi/English with English/Hindi as a subject at degree level
initialExam.qualifications: Master's Degree in Hindi with English as compulsory subject or vice versa
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I: General Hindi & General English (Objective). Paper II: Translation & Essay (Descriptive) - Hindi to English and English to Hindi translation.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 200 marks, 2 hours (Objective). Paper II: 200 marks, 2 hours (Descriptive - Translation & Essay).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Paper I (CBT) → Paper II (Descriptive) → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Translator in central government offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Translator → Senior Translator → Assistant Director (OL) → Deputy Director → Director (Official Language).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical Benefits, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
